# Bid the hang, the take-down, and the extras.

> Price Christmas lights from eave lineal feet, hang-only versus hang-and-takedown versus full-service storage, 1-story versus 2-story versus 3-story access, and extras — plus the walk-away price a $3 / LF hang special cannot see.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
